## Progress

- Merged [PR #40](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/40): `UaeRules`: minimum fields (Emirates ID or passport), EID format 784-YYYY-NNNNNNN-N (15 digits accepted and normalised), expired EID is a warning only, emirate required and mapped to the HIE label (Malaffi / NABIDH / Riayati), Arabic name stored; Emirates ID and insurance member number stored with Always Encrypted; synthetic UAE seed (`--uae`)
- Left: P-02 UAE UI (RTL Arabic name input, preview card, review step, format copy), HIE label on the consent screen (MDV-P1-019), configuration test that a UAE tenant cannot be created in the India deployment (MDV-P0-006); country comes from the caller until the tenant country is on the request context

## Description

UAE variant: full name as on EID (English) + Arabic name (RTL input, Noto Sans Arabic), DOB, sex, nationality, preferred language, Emirates ID (format 784-YYYY-NNNNNNN-N) and expiry, passport/visa for visitors; UAE address (villa/building, area, emirate required, Makani optional, P.O. Box); payer insurance/self-pay/corporate with insurer/plan, member card no. (Always Encrypted), card expiry, network; eligibility marked "M4/P5".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Minimum to register (UAE): name, DOB, sex, mobile and Emirates ID or passport.
- [ ] **AC2.** Invalid EID format shows "Format 784-YYYY-NNNNNNN-N"; an expired EID shows a warning but never blocks registration.
- [ ] **AC3.** Arabic name field accepts RTL input and displays correctly in the preview card and review step.
- [ ] **AC4.** The selected emirate determines the HIE label (Malaffi / NABIDH / Riayati) shown in consents (no connection in P1).
- [ ] **AC5.** UAE tenant data is stored only in the UAE deployment (configuration test: UAE tenant cannot be created in the India deployment).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
